name: @argszero/dsh-thinking-roundtrip-guard
description: Keeps a mixed-provider session usable on a Messages route that requires thinking blocks back. When a route has thinking enabled, every historical assistant turn that carries a tool call must also carry a thinking block; a turn produced on another route has none, so the provider answers 400 to every later request and the session is stuck. This plugin repairs the outbound request at the llm/stream boundary - it synthesizes the missing thinking block for those turns (a signature is not required, measured), or degrades the request to thinking off, and falls back to the degrade path when the provider still rejects it. Zero runtime dependencies, fail-open, append-only session log untouched.
